accept_message: Congratulations! You have completed the Umrah rituals. May Allah accept it from you.
app_desc: Your companion for Ramadan and beyond. May Allah accept your worship. 🌙
dhikr_safa_marwa_standing_trans: Allah is the Greatest (3 times). There is no god but Allah alone, Who has no partner, His is the dominion and to Him belongs all praise, and He is Able to do all things...
dua_rabbana_atina_trans: Our Lord, give us in this world that which is good and in the Hereafter that which is good and protect us from the punishment of the Fire.
dua_rabbi_ighfir_trans: My Lord, forgive and have mercy, and overlook that which You know, for You are the Most Mighty, the Most Generous.
dua_allahumma_inni_asaluka_trans: O Allah, I ask You for guidance, piety, abstinence, and self-sufficiency.
may_allah_accept: May Allah accept from us and you
lahawla: There is no power nor strength except with Allah

calibration_instruction:
Move your phone in a figure-8 pattern
to calibrate the compass sensor
calibration_tips:
• Keep away from metal objects
• Move phone smoothly in air
• Takes about 5-10 seconds
• Repeat if compass seems inaccurate
qibla_instructions:
• Rotate your phone until the arrow points up
• Keep away from metal objects and magnets
• Calibrate compass if readings seem inaccurate
notification_adhan_body: It is time for {} prayer. May Allah accept your worship.
notification_iqama_body: Time for {} Iqama. Please prepare for prayer.
guide_ihram_1: Make intention for Umrah in your heart, it is recommended to verbalize it.
guide_ihram_2: Perform a full ritual bath (Ghusl), even for menstruating women or women in postpartum bleeding.
guide_ihram_3: Wear Ihram clothes (two white seamless sheets for men, any modest clothing for women).
guide_ihram_4: Pray two rak'ahs of Sunnah prayer (after ablution or a fard prayer).
guide_ihram_5: Recite Talbiyah: "Labbayk Allahumma Umrah" and increase in its recitation.
guide_ihram_6: Recite the condition Dua (optional for those fearing an emergency): "Allahumma mahilli haythu habastani".
guide_entrance_1: Ensure you have Wudu (ablution) upon arriving at the Haram.
guide_entrance_2: Enter with your right foot and recite the Dua for entering the mosque.
guide_entrance_3: Face the Kaaba upon seeing it, raise your hands, and make any supplication you wish.
guide_tawaf_1: Perform seven circuits (Tawaf) starting from the Black Stone, keeping the Kaaba to your left.
guide_tawaf_2: Conditions for Tawaf: Purity, covering the awrah, keeping the Kaaba to your left, and performing Tawaf outside Hijr Ismail.
guide_tawaf_3: Make any supplication you wish during Tawaf; there are no specific prescribed duas.
guide_tawaf_4: Pray two rak'ahs behind Maqam Ibrahim if possible, or anywhere else in the Haram.
guide_tawaf_5: Drink Zamzam water and make Dua.
guide_sai_1: Perform seven laps of Sa'i, starting from Safa and ending at Marwa.
guide_sai_2: Upon starting from Safa, recite: "Indeed, Safa and Marwa are among the symbols of Allah..."
guide_sai_3: Upon reaching Safa or Marwa: Face the Qibla, say "Allahu Akbar" three times, and recite the prescribed Dhikr.
guide_sai_4: Repeat the Dhikr 3 times and make Dua twice in between.
guide_sai_5: Duas during Sa'i: There are no specific prescribed duas; make any supplication you wish.
guide_tahlul_1: For men: Shave or trim all hair (shaving is preferred).
guide_tahlul_2: For women: Cut a fingertip's length from the ends of their hair.
guide_tahlul_3: Release from Ihram, meaning all prohibitions are lifted, and regular clothes can be worn.
dua_ihram_trans: I respond to Your call for Umrah. I am here, O Allah, here I am...
dua_tawaf_trans: Our Lord, give us in this world that which is good and in the Hereafter that which is good...
dua_sai_trans: Behold! Safa and Marwa are among the Symbols of Allah...
fajr_dua_1: Allahumma inni as'aluka 'ilman nafi'an, wa rizqan tayyiban, wa 'amalan mutaqabbalan
dhuhr_dua_1: Allahumma a'inni 'ala dhikrika wa shukrika wa husni 'ibadatik
dhuhr_dua_2: Allahumma inni a'udhu bika min 'ilmin la yanfa'u, wa min qalbin la yakhsha'u
asr_dua_1: Allahumma inni a'udhu bika min al-kasali wal-harami wal-ma'thami wal-maghrami
asr_dua_2: Allahumma inni as'aluka al-'afiyah fi dini wa dunyaya wa ahli wa mali
duha_dua_1: Allahumma innaka 'afuwwun kareemun tuhibbu al-'afwa fa'fu 'anni
duha_dua_2: Allahumma salli 'ala Muhammad wa 'ala ali Muhammad
